content:
Harper (SRE): Uploaded postmortem for the recent Dedicated tenant bleed (peering failover + on-prem route-policy mismatch). Doc link in the incidents folder. Short: timing gap during peering transition exposed a stale on-prem default-originate.

build-bot: Postmortem created: /incidents/1905550210-dedicated-tenant-bleed.md :rotating_light:

Vik (Platform): Can we capture owners & deadlines here so infra can triage?

Harper (SRE): Action list:
1) Peering health daemon (control-plane + data-plane handshake) — owner: Vik (Platform) — due: 2026-06-09
2) On-prem policy detector e2e tests + sample fixtures — owner: Nora (Support) — due: 2026-06-16
3) Dedicated onboarding isolation verification (passive default, active opt-in) — owner: Nora (Support) — due: 2026-06-02
4) Customer comms + NOC safe-check one-pager — owner: Felix (Customer Success) — due: 2026-05-31
5) Security review of capture & artifact retention (redaction rules) — owner: Samira (Sec) — due: 2026-06-03

Nora (Support): For #2/3 I'll prepare passive-only scripts (ip route, ip neigh, iptables -L) and optional active capture with consent. Will include short reproducible fixtures. ETA 5 days.

Vik (Platform): Plan for #1: daemonset on Dedicated nodes, run probes from node netns, dual check: `describe-vpc-peering-connections` + small TCP handshake to peer control IPs. I'll open INF-8032 and PR the probe today.

Samira (Sec): Security note: probes/captures must redacted before storage. Use ephemeral S3 with server-side encryption and automated redaction job. I'll add policy to INF-8032.

Felix (Customer Success): I'll draft comms and the one-pager. Sending to legal for review (expect ~48h). Can we include an actionable checklist customers can run without sharing logs?

Harper (SRE): Yes — make the NOC checklist passive-first with an opt-in section for active steps. Also: recurring pattern note — this is the 3rd peering-route incident in ~9 months with similar default-originate edges. Proposal: monthly "isolation-pattern" retro to prioritize linter rules. Owner: Harper. Kickoff: 2026-06-04.

Vik (Platform): Also proposing an onboarding linter rule to block default-originate entries lacking next-hop validation. Will add INF-8033.

Nora (Support): Quick Q — many customers won't permit captures. Confirm passive-only mode is fine for initial verification?

Harper (SRE): Confirmed. Passive-only default; active captures require explicit customer opt-in and legal sign-off per Samira. Document both modes in the runbook.

Vik (Platform): I'll add PR & ticket links to the postmortem follow-ups when ready. Harper, can you run a 2-week follow-up check on 2026-06-23?

Harper (SRE): Yep — 2-week check scheduled. Everyone please add issue/PR links to the postmortem before then. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
